title: Le tueur
writer: Pascal Jardin, Denys de La Patellière
actors: Jean Gabin, Fabio Testi, Uschi Glas
plot: Whilst being transferred to a psychiatric hospital, a ruthless serial killer Gassot makes a break and goes on the run. He arrives in Marseilles, intending to escape abroad. Here, he falls for a young prostitute, Gerda.
